_comment: DEV SET — Phase 3 B1. 12 questions, 2 per category. This set is used ONLY for debugging the harness, the grader, and prompt fixes. It is NEVER scored in the results table and NEVER reported as a result. Written BEFORE any TEST question was generated. Do not merge with test.json.
